system.roleplaying: You are constantly assessing the situation, making plans and backup plans, and then reassessing the situation.
system.minorTwist: What one variable did your plan not account for?
system.majorTwist: What major threat is revealed that invalidates all your plans?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Tactician
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome when you can flashback to how you prepared for this exact situation. Use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
